prompt:
Design a sleek, modern enterprise mobile login screen for "PeoplePay360" (390x844px), matching the Odoo 18 Enterprise Modern + Apple Human Interface Design System + Glassmorphism specifications.

Use the brand logo {{DATA:IMAGE:IMAGE_2}}.

Visual Hierarchy & Layout:
1. Top Section (Aubergine Gradient Header):
   - Deep rich gradient from #714B67 to #4A2E43 with subtle ambient lighting.
   - Minimalist glowing Odoo-style app mark using {{DATA:IMAGE:IMAGE_2}} (48x48px) with subtle backdrop glow.
   - Brand title: "PeoplePay360" in bold white (22px, Outfit font) with subtitle badge: "Enterprise HR & Payroll • Odoo 18".
   - Headline: "Welcome Back" (24px, Bold, tracking -0.5px, text-white) with subtext: "Sign in to continue to your workspace." (14px, rgba(255,255,255,0.8)).

2. Center Card (Elevated Glass Surface):
   - Crisp white card container with rounded corners (24px), 1px border (#E2E8F0/border-slate-200), and soft multi-layered elevation shadow (0 10px 30px -4px rgba(113, 75, 103, 0.12)).
   - Field 1: Work Email input field:
     - Label: "Work Email" (13px, font-medium, #0F172A)
     - Input box with mail icon (SVG), value/placeholder "alex.morgan@enterprise.odoo.com", clean focus ring in Odoo Teal (#017E84), and a green checkmark validation indicator badge ("Verified Domain").
   - Field 2: Password input field:
     - Label: "Password" (13px, font-medium, #0F172A)
     - Input box with lock icon (SVG), masked password "••••••••••••", and an interactive toggle eye icon.
   - Extra row: Remember me checkbox ("Keep me signed in") and "Forgot Password?" link aligned right in primary aubergine (#714B67, font-semibold hover:underline).
   - Primary Action Button:
     - "Sign In to Workspace" with deep aubergine fill (#714B67), pill shape (rounded-full), bold white text, subtle arrow icon, and hover shadow glow.
   - Biometric option:
     - "or sign in with Face ID" button with FaceID SVG icon and soft slate border.

3. Quick Role Demo Switcher (Hackathon Standout Feature):
   - Dedicated section labeled: "⚡ Quick Demo Roles (1-Tap Fast Evaluation)" with subtitle "Instantly populate credentials for judging".
   - Horizontal pill selector tags:
     - [ ★ Admin ] (aubergine highlight badge, "SysAdmin • Full Access")
     - [ HR Manager ] ("Sarah Jenkins • HR Lead")
     - [ Payroll User ] ("David Kim • Finance & Comp")
     - [ Employee ] ("Elena Rostova • Engineering")
   - Include lightweight vanilla JS to let the user tap any pill to populate the email and role preview dynamically with a smooth feedback state.

4. Bottom Legal Footer:
   - "Secured by Odoo Enterprise RBAC • Version 2026.1" in 11px muted gray (#64748B) with an encrypted lock badge.
   - Company switcher preview: "Acme Global Industries (US-East Cluster)".

Ensure high contrast, immaculate typography, 16px/24px rounded corners, and pixel perfection.

designSystem.styleGuidelines:
## Brand & Style

This design system blends the operational rigor of modern enterprise ERP interfaces with the tactile fluidity of Apple Human Interface Guidelines and frosted glassmorphism. Built specifically for mission-critical mobile HR and payroll operations, it balances executive prestige with day-to-day administrative speed.

### Visual Signature
- **Style Archetype:** Enterprise Modern Glassmorphism. Translucent floating surfaces, crisp 1px structural boundaries, subtle specular edge reflections, and ambient depth tinted with brand pigments.
- **Tone & Mood:** Authoritative, dependable, frictionless, and premium. Complex payroll data and approval workflows feel serene and legible rather than overwhelming.
- **Form & Tactility:** Glass cards float over a calibrated slate backdrop, anchoring dense financial figures and employee statuses with high legibility and clear touch affordances.

## Layout & Spacing

This design system uses a strict 4px/8px incremental base grid tuned for handheld enterprise usage:

- **Mobile Grid:** Single-column layout with 16px screen margins (`margin-screen`) and 12px or 16px vertical gutters between card modules. All primary tap targets are pinned to a minimum hit box of 48px × 48px.
- **Tablet / Split View Grid:** 6-column fluid responsive grid with 24px gutters, enabling side-by-side employee list navigation and detailed payslip previews without contextual switching.
- **Safe Area Insets:** Fixed bottom action ribbons integrate dynamic safe-area padding (`env(safe-area-inset-bottom) + 12px`) to float smoothly above mobile home indicators.

## Elevation & Depth

Visual depth is achieved through layered frosted glass combined with soft, aubergine-tinted ambient shadows. This keeps the interface airy while differentiating interactive controls from fixed backdrops.

### Elevation Levels

- **Base (Level 0 - Ground):** Flat `#F8FAFC` (Light) or `#0B0F17` (Dark). No elevation.
- **Level 1 (Card & Module Layer):** Background `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85)` with `backdrop-filter: blur(8px)`, bound by a 1px solid border of `#E2E8F0`. Shadow: `0 4px 16px -2px rgba(113, 75, 103, 0.06), 0 1px 3px 0 rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.04)`.
- **Level 2 (Floating Controls & Smart Buttons):** Elevated actionable glass. Shadow: `0 8px 24px -4px rgba(113, 75, 103, 0.12), 0 2px 6px -1px rgba(1, 126, 132, 0.08)`.
- **Level 3 (Modals, Action Drawers, & Sticky Footers):** Background `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.94)` with `backdrop-filter: blur(16px)` and top border highlight `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.6)`. Shadow: `0 20px 40px -8px rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.2), 0 0 1px 1px rgba(113, 75, 103, 0.08)`.
- **Dark Mode Elevation:** Replace white translucent fills with `rgba(22, 31, 48, 0.75)` and tune aubergine cast shadows to `rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45)` with a 1px inner specular glow `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.06)`.

## Components

### Buttons
- **Primary Aubergine:** Full capsule (24px radius), 48px height. Background `#714B67`, text `#FFFFFF`, subtle inner bevel `inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2)`. Active press drops opacity to 0.9 and scales to 0.98.
- **Smart / Stat Buttons (Teal Accent):** Capsule button with `#017E84` tint at 10% background fill, `#017E84` 1px border, and `#017E84` bold label text with an embedded JetBrains Mono numerical badge.
- **Secondary Glass:** Translucent `#FFFFFF` (60% opacity), 1px border `#E2E8F0`, text `#0F172A`.

### Cards & Payslip Modules
- 16px corner radius, 1px border `#E2E8F0`, `backdrop-filter: blur(8px)`.
- **Financial Header:** Outfit Bold for net pay display, accompanied by a JetBrains Mono currency code (`USD`, `EUR`) and an Emerald Green `#10B981` status pill.
- **Inner Dividers:** Subtle dotted or translucent lines `rgba(226, 232, 240, 0.8)` separating gross earnings, tax withholdings, and net distributions.

### Input Fields & Search Bars
- 12px corner radius, 44px height, background `rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9)`.
- Border is 1px `#CBD5E1`. On focus: 1.5px `#714B67` with a soft 3px blur ring `rgba(113, 75, 103, 0.15)`.
- Floating labels in Plus Jakarta Sans 12px; active monetary values formatted in JetBrains Mono.

### Chips & Status Badges
- 24px full pill radius, 24px height, padding 4px 10px.
- **Paid / Validated:** Background `rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.12)`, text `#047857`, 1px border `rgba(16, 185, 129, 0.25)`.
- **To Approve / Pending:** Background `rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.12)`, text `#B45309`, 1px border `rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.25)`.
- **Refused / Overdue:** Background `rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.12)`, text `#B91C1C`, 1px border `rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.25)`.

### Lists & Activity Rows
- Edge-to-edge glass container with 16px outer radius.
- List items feature 1px separator lines inset by 56px to clear leading employee avatar or category icons.
- Right accessory shows JetBrains Mono timestamp or monetary differential with a trailing chevron icon.

### Checkboxes & Radio Controls
- 6px rounded checkbox (20px × 20px) or 20px full circle radio.
- Unchecked: 1.5px border `#94A3B8`, clear background.
- Checked: `#714B67` fill with crisp white checkmark or center pip.

The color palette balances a signature aubergine authority with active functional teal and a slate neutral scale. Semantic colors deliver clear signals for payroll statuses, approvals, and anomalies.

### Theme Modes

- **Brand Primary (Aubergine):** `#714B67` — primary navigation, master actions, executive metrics, and active states.
- **Accent & Smart Actions (Teal):** `#017E84` — smart buttons, actionable links, positive interactive cues, and inline toggles.
- **Canvas Background:** `#F8FAFC` (Slate 50) — clean, glare-free ground for elevated glass layers.
- **Card Surface:** `#FFFFFF` at 85% opacity with 8px backdrop blur and `#E2E8F0` border.
- **Text Primary:** `#0F172A` (Slate 900) — high-contrast clarity for dense data.
- **Text Muted:** `#64748B` (Slate 500) — metadata, secondary timestamps, and input hints.

#### Dark Mode
- **Brand Primary (Aubergine Glow):** `#8E6083` — brightened for legibility against deep dark substrates.
- **Accent & Smart Actions (Teal Glow):** `#00A09D` — luminous interaction targets and active tags.
- **Canvas Background:** `#0B0F17` (Deep Obsidian) — minimizes OLED power consumption and eye fatigue during late-night payroll cycles.
- **Card Surface:** `#161F30` at 75% opacity with 12px backdrop blur and `#334155` border.
- **Text Primary:** `#F8FAFC` (Slate 50).
- **Text Muted:** `#94A3B8` (Slate 400).

### Semantic Accents
- **Success / Active / Paid:** `#10B981` (Emerald Green) — pay runs confirmed, attendance validated, deposits processed.
- **Warning / Pending / Anomaly:** `#F59E0B` (Amber Flame) — pending approvals, overtime discrepancies, tax form alerts.
- **Danger / Refused / Absent:** `#EF4444` (Crimson Red) — unexcused absences, rejected expense claims, compliance blocks.

2. **Plus Jakarta Sans (Body & Context):** Clean, humanist curves optimized for high legibility at micro sizes on retina displays. Used across data lists, workflow descriptions, and form labels.
3. **JetBrains Mono (Codes, Timestamps & Currency):** Monospaced numeric alignment guarantees that payslip balances, employee IDs, tax calculations, and hourly timesheet rates never jump or misalign when values update in real time.
